summary: Ceiling integer division: computes (a1 + a2 - 1) / a2, i.e. the smallest integer quotient q such that q*a2 >= a1. Pure arithmetic helper with no state access; the division is signed. Used by TextureSurfaceValidator (005159f5), AudioVoiceChannelAllocation (00515bb0) and sub_516A1D (00516a1d), consistent with a rounding-up utility shared across size/stride and channel-count computations.

local_names.a2: positive divisor; also the rounding bias subtracts 1

operations.description: Compute the biased numerator a1 + a2 - 1, which makes the subsequent integer division round up for non-exact quotients
